headline: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter
summary: NASA's new telescope, 1,000 times faster than Hubble, embarks on a mission to map the dark universe and directly image exoplanets.
details: After facing funding challenges and a name change, NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has successfully launched. It will now undertake a three-month, one-million-mile journey to its operational orbit at the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point (L2), located beyond the Moon.

From its vantage point, Roman is poised to conduct an unprecedented survey of the universe. Its field of view is 100 times larger than Hubble's, and NASA states it can survey the sky 1,000 times faster thanks to its 300-megapixel infrared camera.

The telescope is equipped with a Coronagraph system designed to block starlight, enabling direct imaging of exoplanets. This capability will allow scientists to observe smaller, older, and colder planets that orbit close to their stars.

Roman will also perform detailed 3D scans to help map the distribution of dark matter and identify potential candidates for its composition. These scans, combined with gravitational lensing measurements, will be used to map how dark energy has influenced the evolution of the universe.

Nicky Fox, associate administrator for NASA's Science Mission Directorate, expressed that "Roman will be a discovery machine that will bring us closer than ever before to answering humanity’s most profound questions about our cosmic history."

headline: LG UltraGear 34-inch OLED monitor drops to $599.99, 50% off
summary: This 240 Hz ultrawide gaming monitor with a 0.03ms response time is now available for half its original $1,200 price, making it a prime candidate for upgrade.
details: LG's 34-inch UltraGear 34GX900A-B ultrawide OLED gaming monitor is currently on sale for $599.99 on Amazon, a 50% discount from its original $1,200 price.
The monitor boasts a 3440 x 1440 WQHD resolution with a fast 240 Hz refresh rate and an ultra-low 0.03ms response time, ensuring smooth and responsive gameplay.
It features an immersive 800R curve, up to 1300 nits of brightness, and supports DisplayHDR True Black 400 for deep blacks and vibrant colors, covering 98.5% of the DCI-P3 color gamut.

For enhanced visual clarity, it includes FreeSync Premium Pro and Nvidia G-Sync compatibility to eliminate screen tearing. The display is also UL-verified for flicker and glare reduction, and low-blue-light output for comfortable extended use.

Connectivity options include two HDMI 2.1 ports, DisplayPort 1.4, USB Type-C with power delivery, two USB Type-A ports, and a 3.5mm audio jack. Additional features include a screen-splitting app and an adjustable stand.
